item_name: Sabre Pepper Gas w/ Hard Case ''Special Formula'' HC-14-US
item_short_desc: Sabre Pepper Gas with Hard Case features a special formula designed for maximum stopping power. Legal for sale in 50 States. NY, MA and HI require FFL for purchase.
description: Sabre Pepper Gas with Hard Case features a special formula designed for maximum stopping power. With a ballistic stream and range of 8 - 10 feet, this pepper spray decreases wind blow-back for optimal effectiveness. Features a hard case with quick release key ring for easy access and hands-free carry. Sabre Pepper Gas holds approximately 25 shots, has a shelf life of 4 years and is ISO 9001 Certified.
